region_scene_page.compact: Modern indie folk grew as alternative audiences rediscovered banjos, harmonies, acoustic guitars, and rustic imagery through indie labels, blogs, festivals, and streaming.
region_scene_page.standard: Modern indie folk grew as alternative audiences rediscovered banjos, harmonies, acoustic guitars, and rustic imagery through indie labels, blogs, festivals, and streaming. The Lumineers' Stubborn Love, Bon Iver, Fleet Foxes, and Mumford & Sons give the scene its high-recognition landmarks.
region_scene_page.deep: Modern indie folk grew as alternative audiences rediscovered banjos, harmonies, acoustic guitars, and rustic imagery through indie labels, blogs, festivals, and streaming. Old instruments are framed with modern indie dynamics: roomy recordings, gang vocals, stomps, and emotional restraint or release. The Lumineers' Stubborn Love, Bon Iver, Fleet Foxes, and Mumford & Sons give the scene its high-recognition landmarks. From there, the examples move from quick recognition toward medium and deeper scene signals.
